target_negative.recorded_cause: the role_boost component (exact token matches) introduced marginal statistics that survive label shuffling

support_declaration.why: Three instruments this session failed by freezing a predicate before characterising the population's support. This declares support first.
support_declaration.population: research/paper2_external_corpus_v1/data/arn.csv, 1095 rows, 2190 pairs, CONFIRM split as defined by the parent protocol
support_declaration.predicate_in_domain: yes — B3 shuffled-gold is already implemented in the v4 runner and produced the leak being repaired, so the population demonstrably supports the measurement
support_declaration.known_conditioning_variable: distractor_similarity (high/low). research/arn_local_vs_parent_discriminator_v1 measured a 0.217 accuracy spread across these bands for lexical features, so surface-overlap effects are known to be band-dependent and MUST be reported per band, not only pooled
support_declaration.reachable_ceiling: not bounded a priori. If the relational channel alone carries no signal, G1 fails and the epoch closes NEGATIVE__CAPABILITY_ABSENT — an admissible outcome for a repaired instrument, not a defect of the repair
support_declaration.cost: deterministic, single-threaded, local; no hosted model, no A100, no new annotation

exact_change.after: score = (1 - w) * triple_score + w * role_boost, with w = RAKL_ARN_ROLE_BOOST_WEIGHT, default 0.2
exact_change.why_a_weight_and_not_a_deletion: the default preserves v4 byte-for-byte, so the repaired and original arms differ in exactly one declared parameter and the v4 terminal remains reproducible
exact_change.not_changed: the runner, the reducer, the abstention conditions, the thresholds, the split, the battery, the gates, the bootstrap seed

frozen_decision_rule.R1_leak_must_die: B3 shuffled-gold advantage CI must include zero. If it still excludes zero, the repair failed and the terminal stays BATTERY_FAILED__INSTRUMENT_NOT_PROBATIVE.
frozen_decision_rule.R2_text_reading_must_survive: B2 text-destruction must still pass; a repair that also destroys the instrument's ability to read text is not a repair.
frozen_decision_rule.R3_then_and_only_then_report_G1: the confirmatory advantage on unshuffled gold is read ONLY if R1 and R2 both hold. Reporting a G1 advantage from an instrument that still leaks is the defect being repaired.
frozen_decision_rule.R4_per_band: G1 and B3 are reported per distractor_similarity band as well as pooled, because the conditioning variable is known to matter.

terminals.REPAIRED_AND_PROBATIVE: R1 and R2 hold and G1 clears its registered MDE with CI excluding zero
terminals.REPAIRED_BUT_CAPABILITY_ABSENT: R1 and R2 hold and G1 does not clear the MDE — the instrument is now honest and the relational channel carries no sufficient signal

falsifier: REPAIRED_BUT_CAPABILITY_ABSENT is the outcome that refutes the hope motivating this repair: it would mean the v4 advantage was the leak and nothing else. That is the expected direction of failure and it will be reported as the result, not as a reason to try another weight.
non_claims: No weight other than 0.0 will be tried. Sweeping the weight after seeing outcomes is threshold rescue.
This does not retract the v4 terminal, which stands under its own protocol.
A repaired instrument is not a positive result about analogical transfer; it is an instrument that no longer reads its own marginals.
Grants no scientific or method-promotion authority.
